from app.reports import Order, orders_between, revenue

        Order(1, date(2026, 2, 28), 100),
        Order(2, date(2026, 3, 1), 100),
        Order(3, date(2026, 3, 31), 100),
        Order(4, date(2026, 4, 1), 100),
    ]
    result = orders_between(orders, date(2026, 3, 1), date(2026, 3, 31))

input.summary: orders_between used an exclusive upper bound (`< end`), so orders on the end date were dropped. I changed it to `<= end` and added a regression test.

claims.statement: Root cause: the filter used `start <= o.placed_on < end`, excluding the end date
Regression test failed before the fix (got [2] instead of [2,3])
After changing to `<=`, all tests pass

input.uncertainty: Only the date-typed inputs were tested; if placed_on were ever a datetime, comparison semantics would differ. No other callers exist in the repo (single search hit).
